title: Decode Ways II
goal: Count letter decodings when an asterisk can represent any digit from one to nine.
strategy: At each position, combine valid one-character decodings with valid two-character decodings. Wildcard pair multiplicities depend on both symbols, and zero is valid only in a suitable pair.

edgeCases: A leading zero prevents every decoding
Two wildcard pairs around zero change pair availability
A wildcard after three cannot join it into a letter
